{{Top|leg}}
The '''Utility Ward''' was the part of [[Point Nadir]] that housed all the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] controls, and [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems that kept the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] running. It was controlled by the [[Anjiliac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], but used many [[Epsis (organization)|Epsis]] techs to keep it running which effectively gave them control.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

Since it was so vital, it was one of the most secure areas in Point Nadir. It was guarded by Epsis [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and Anjiliac clan thugs.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
